email.body:
You said today, in your sprint retro: "We shipped the async decision widget. Velocity was 23 points, highest this quarter. The Zephyr integration was the key unlock." That is the first delivery of the widget written down anywhere.

So now the decision-capture idea has a shipped widget behind it, where until today it had only the core thesis. The Zephyr integration is the reason you gave for getting it out. Nobody has pushed back on the idea yet.

I read that as the Zephyr integration being what got the widget out the door, which makes it the dependency to protect. If that holds, the 23-point sprint is a reasonable reference for planning the next one, though one sprint is a thin base. My read is that the decision-capture idea has gone from a claim to something that ships.

Does the Zephyr integration cover Teams and Discord yet, or only Slack? Is the widget catching decisions on teams beyond yours, or only this sprint's work? Does the 23-point figure hold if the team counts differently?
